normal: paragraph: The providers SendMock emulates: what their checkout offers, what they send back to your app, and the notifications they post.
Add a payment gateway dialog: paragraph: Emulate a provider SendMock does not ship; you set its checkout, redirect and notification next.
paragraph: The provider value in the API; fixed once added.
Gateway editor: paragraph: Built-in gateway, key stripe . # payments.
paragraph: The provider value in the API and in /providers/<key>/... paths; fixed once added.
paragraph: Used on its checkout pages.
Gateway editor, Checkout tab: paragraph: One method shows its flow directly; several show a picker, in this order.
paragraph: Creates a test payment with this gateway and opens its checkout page.
Gateway editor, Merchant tab: paragraph: Templates read them as merchant.<name> . Secrets stay masked; the preview masks them too.
paragraph: Its IPN or webhook deliveries go to this webhook endpoint, with retries and replay.
Gateway editor, Redirect tab: radio: GET The fields go in the query string (Stripe, PayPal).
radio: POST The browser posts a form with the fields (SSLCommerz).
paragraph: Type {{ for suggestions; {{ redirect.status }} is this gateway's event name for the outcome.
Gateway editor, Notification tab: radio: Form application/x-www-form-urlencoded; write the body as name=value&... (SSLCommerz IPN).
paragraph: This gateway's name for each event, read as {{ event.name }} . Leave one blank and nothing is sent for it.
failing: alert: Could not load the gateways. Try again
paragraph: Could not load the gateways.
